entries.summary: When the group leader teleports, followers now jump there too. Turn off Follow leader teleports to walk instead.
Added a Simplified Chinese translation for the app's interface.
Speed profile names and a few remaining screens now show in the chosen display language instead of falling back to English.
The floating joystick, floating widget, and background notification now follow the chosen display language on Android 9-12, matching the rest of the app.
Android 13 and up can now list this app's available languages in its own language-picker Settings screen.
Play Store downloads now include every supported language instead of only the one matching the device's system locale at install time.
On first launch, the map now opens at your phone's real location instead of a default city. Your remembered position still wins when you have one.
Added a Language row to onboarding and Settings so you can pick English or Simplified Chinese without changing your phone's system language.
